name: PHOBOS
source:
A spaceship crash leaves seven crew members stranded. The planet offers materials to rebuild, yet unseen forces threaten their sanity. Can they fix the ship, or will madness claim them?

[From [url=https://aka-fish.itch.io/phobos]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
宇宙飞船失事，七名船员被困。这个星球提供了重建所需的材料，但看不见的力量却威胁着他们的理智。他们能修好船吗，还是疯狂会夺走他们？

[来自[url=https://aka-fish.itch.io/phobos]Itch.io[/url]]
